page.title: Bag holding Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb

product.name: Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb
product.description: The flour is milled from whole rye berries and packed in a paper sack.

blocks.text: The tag on Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb was $41.62.
The amount to be billed is fifty eight dollars and forty two cents.
No packing line is added. Heel cap at $8.73 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
Returns are accepted within 30 days when the seal is still intact.
